Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 11028 - 1984 




Indian Standard 



( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 



SPECIFICATION FOR 
HANDLE BARS FOR MOPEDS 



1. Scope — Covers the requirements for handle bars for mopeds. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — The recommended shape and dimensions of a typical handle bar is 
given in the figure below: 

All dimensions in millimetres. 




130 TRUE LENGTH 
UNPOLISHED 



2.1 The dimensions of tubes shall be as per IS : 5429-1979 'Dimensions for steel tubes for automotive 
purposes { first revision y, 

3. Material —The handle bars shall be made from steel tubes of ERW grade conforming to 
is ; 3074-1979 'Specification for steel tubes for automotive purposes ( first revision )'. 

4. General Requirements — The tubes for handle bars shall be free from burrs and sharp edges, 
smooth and without any manufacturing defects. 

5. IVIanufacture — The tubes for handle bars shall be bent through the specified angles without any 
rapture at the bent position. The ends shall be smooth and even, suitable for easy fitting of handle 
grips. A straight knurl may be provided at the central position for proper gripping of bars to the frame. 

6. Finish ~ The handle bars shall be nickel chromium plated to service grade No. 2 with designation 
SNi 20b Cr r of IS : 1068-1968 'Specification for electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on iron 
and steel ( first revision )'. 



Adopted 29 August 1984 



O December 1984, ISI 



Gr 1 



INDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION 

MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG 

NEW DELHI 110002 



18:11028-1984 

7. Tests — Shall be as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 

8. Marking — Eaeh handle bar shall be marked with the manufacturer's identification marlc. 
8.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

9. Packing — Each handle bar shall be packed as per best prevalent trade practice. 

10. Sampling— Unless otherwise agreed upon between the supplier and the purchaser the sampling 
scheme shall be in accordance with IS : 2600 ( Part 1 ) 1973 'Sampling inspection tables : Part 1 
Inspection by attributes and by count of defects ( first revision )'.
